newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Turnover on Romania OTC market on the rise.
newsitem.headline: Turnover on Romania OTC market on the rise.

text.p: Turnover on the Romanian over-the-counter (OTC) market in five days of trading this week rose to 795 million lei from 486 million a week ago, according to data released on Friday by the RASDAQ trading system.
A RASDAQ report showed new stocks had joined the market this week, almost doubling the number of OTC listings to 1,026.
The RASDAQ, which opened late in October, is expected ultimately to trade shares in some 5,000 companies.
An average 45 stocks were traded on each of the five days. A total 1.063 million shares changed hands.
The week's most heavily traded stock was IMEP SA, an electric motor maker, with more than 720,500 shares traded.
On Friday IMEP closed at 650 lei, unchanged from both Monday's and last Friday's closing price. ($=3,732 lei) -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
